review_scope: MOD-INF-001 first-release CPU profile implementation, public-boundary startup, fault, numeric, supply-chain and gate evidence

findings.title: Gateway model path hardcoded to <repo>/model.onnx instead of the closure model member
findings.resolution: Warmup and service ORT sessions now resolve the model path from the digest-pinned closure manifest (unique role=model member rel_path) via resolve_model_path(); no config drift possible. Verified by real-process E2E (module_blackbox MASI_INF_E2E=1).

findings.title: ORT CPU EP appended via string provider API unsupported by the CPU-only archive
findings.resolution: Replaced string-keyed AppendExecutionProvider with the typed OrtSessionOptionsAppendExecutionProvider_CPU (cpu_provider_factory.h) and contract-fixed arena flag; startup warmup now passes on ORT 1.19.0 CPU-only.

findings.title: Triton model name derived from model_revision_digest, never matching the repository; startup tolerated missing model metadata
findings.resolution: Triton model name now comes from the closure model member directory name (resolve_triton_model_name()); triton-none-load fails closed on metadata name/version/IO mismatch and records a real metadata digest. Gateway Infer uses the same exact name.

findings.title: Output adapter ignored softmax_output and emitted ALERT on any best score at threshold regardless of argmax class
findings.resolution: apply_output_adapter now applies stable softmax when softmax_output is set and gates ALERT on the argmax class being the alert class with score at threshold; confident benign inputs no longer false-alert. Property tests added; E2E decision=ALERT matches the fixture taxonomy.

findings.title: Frozen golden valid-batch-v1.json carried an undecodable 93-char feature tensor hex and a contradictory expected decision
findings.resolution: Hex corrected to the intended 96-char [5,10,3,16,32,1] uint64 tensor and expected decision aligned with the fixture taxonomy (argmax class 1 -> alert); contract validator still PASS/QUALIFIED.

findings.title: Gateway does not bind client identity beyond CA chain (exact Edge SAN/CN allowlist)
Gateway indexed records(0) before admission; empty batches triggered protobuf CHECK failures
findings.resolution: records(0) access guarded behind records_size()>0; empty batches are now rejected cleanly by admission (record_count out of range, minimum_records_per_batch=1). Blackbox empty-batch test added; zero protobuf CHECK failures in E2E.
